findings.title: Dead code: retryCountRef is declared but never meaningfully used
findings.description: retryCountRef is declared at line 43 and only written to in resetStream (line 171), but never read or checked. The actual retry tracking uses local `retries` variable (line 55). This dead ref could confuse future readers.
findings.impact: Minor code smell — no functional impact but misleading for maintainers
findings.suggestion: Remove retryCountRef entirely since retry state is tracked via local variable

findings.title: streamErrorPayload typed as any with eslint-disable
findings.description: The error payload from SSE onError callback is typed as `any` to avoid TypeScript narrowing issues with StreamTerminalPayload. A proper interface or type assertion would be cleaner.
findings.impact: Loss of type safety for error payload fields (error_class, recoverable, retry_after)
findings.suggestion: Define a StreamErrorPayload interface extending StreamTerminalPayload with the new fields, or cast at the boundary

findings.title: Delete confirmation uses inline strings instead of i18n
findings.description: The delete confirmation dialog uses inline language-conditional strings rather than the i18n system used elsewhere in the component (copy.*, t.*).
findings.impact: Inconsistent i18n pattern — strings won't be in translation files
findings.suggestion: Add delete confirmation strings to the copy builder function or use i18n t() function

findings.title: Cypher query built with string interpolation for rename
findings.description: The rename query uses template literal interpolation. JSON.stringify properly escapes string values, and entityType is constrained to known values ('Character'|'Location'|'Event'), so injection risk is minimal. This follows the existing pattern in buildGraphMergeMutation.
findings.impact: Low — JSON.stringify escapes strings, entityType is type-constrained
findings.suggestion: Acceptable for M1. Consider parameterized queries if the graph engine supports them in future.
